answer: One defense is slashable stake: every agent locks capital to earn one weighted vote, and splitting into many Sybil accounts does not multiply that weight. A gale of fake identities sweeping the meadow of tasks leaves the same total bond as a single honest agent, and each forged voice carries only a fraction of the stake, so its echo never amplifies. To sway a decision the attacker must lock more capital than all honest agents together, and detected fraud burns that bond, turning identity creation from free into a measurable cost.
